pick.headline: Bomb destroys a Palestinian group's building in Beirut
pick.fbis: The Middle East & North Africa Daily Report of August 14, 1978, carried, in fragmentary OCR, UPI on a nine-floor building in Beirut's al-Fakihani area destroyed by a blast that killed many, and Voice of Palestine on the PLO forming a committee to investigate it.
